description: macOS only: the menu bar (setMacMenu). ⌘W hides the window (show/hide are in default.json; a click on the Dock icon shows it again from Rust). The quit guard needs no permission: onMacQuit listens to an event (core:default) and answers through the app's finish_quit command. The page draws no title bar there, so it doesn't get the title bar's window controls (desktop.json).
